stateOwnerDisposition: Owns generation-fenced process lifecycle, durable bounded restart state and the unified durable release-transition journal; Fleet owns immutable release catalog/allow-revoke admission facts and user-task truth remains outside this module.
terminalObserverDisposition: The exact process driver, Agentd readiness/drain acknowledgements and current-generation observations establish lifecycle terminality; drain acknowledgement closes admission but never establishes user-task success.

operations.sourceSemantics: Creates a generation-fenced managed process. After the driver returns an owned main or Matrix handle, failed lease publication retains that handle fenced until observed exit and same-owner exact cleanup. Adopted signals use kernel lifetime references on supported Linux/macOS hosts, never a bare-PID fallback. Driver-internal post-spawn failures and daemon death before a recoverable lease remain open; native execution is unverified.

Consumes exact Agentd/process observations under the active generation, requires critical-store/revocation-baseline/required-port/admission readiness before Running, fences stale processes, and advances bounded durable restart/recovery state without inferring task success.

Transitions the lifecycle fence to Draining and requires an exact typed Agentd Drain acknowledgement for the current spawn/draining generation. Agentd first closes App Server admission and waits for already-admitted RPC handlers, then requires zero running assistant turns and zero unclassified durable Automation/TaskFlow blockers. Durable uncertain/indeterminate effects remain unknown for reconciliation rather than being relabelled complete. A crash after durable Draining replays the idempotent Drain RPC; unavailable drain evidence fails closed into bounded stop escalation, never a drain==SIGTERM shortcut. Pending deadlines are preserved within one daemon only; cross-daemon deadline restoration remains open.

Cancels an existing pending main restart through the canonical restart-record writer before companion deferral, lifecycle CAS and graceful signaling; preserves attempts, window origin, eligibility and companion budget. Internal/deferred process stop does not cancel the restart it implements. This is budget cancellation, not a durable Stop operation: no-runtime daemon admission, cross-daemon termination intent/deadlines and release-change supersession remain open. Process termination is not user-task success.

Attempts durable pending-main-restart cancellation, then owned main termination before companion control. A failed cancellation is reported and fences the retained main handle but cannot suppress emergency termination attempts. Adopted signals use kernel lifetime references; a signal acknowledgement is not observed exit. Complete cross-daemon Kill intent, release-change supersession and target-host execution remain open.

Keeps an unresolved restart claim across budget-window rollover without resetting attempts or original eligibility. Admission, preflight and recovery reject wall-clock rollback before the window origin; internal/deferred Stop preserves the pending claim. Predecessor/replacement identity and complete cross-daemon Stop/Kill operation recovery remain open; budget cancellation alone is not full durable control.

Transitions through a fsynced unified release transaction that binds exact source/target immutable manifests/program bytes, the per-Agent allow/revoke admission frontier, the exact source/target pair identity, lifecycle/release-state generations and optional signed production authority. The pair digest is a structural binding, not independent semantic-compatibility approval; runtime compatibility is established by the typed Agentd/Matrixd readiness contract before commit. A production daemon configured with a verifier rejects unsigned Upgrade/Rollback.

Re-resolves the recorded predecessor at the final-use boundary, rejects revoked or allowance/frontier-drifted releases, verifies its immutable bytes against the durable transaction, and starts rollback only as a fresh process generation.

Admits a production upgrade only after independently signed H7 and production-grant verification binds exact source/target releases and current control/lifecycle/daemon-authority fences. The fsynced release transaction additionally binds immutable program digests plus the current per-Agent admission frontier before drain.

Admits production rollback only through an independently signed grant; the predecessor is freshly re-resolved and its manifest/program digests and current allow/revoke admission frontier must exactly match the durable transaction witness.

Quarantines ambiguous signed transitions as recovery_required while keeping owner-local status/recovery RPCs reachable. An independently signed recovery decision must bind the grant, signed-intent digest, release-transaction digest, observed immutable release bytes and current lifecycle/daemon-authority fences; the current admission frontier is revalidated again before terminal commit/rollback.

repositoryControlledGaps: Native Linux/macOS source-head and deterministic merge-candidate default/production-authority library, product, formatting and strict-lint execution for the exact current candidate.

Complete durable Stop/Kill intent and release-change supersession, no-runtime cancellation admission, bound predecessor/replacement identity and cross-daemon control deadlines; admitted pending-budget cancellation is source-integrated but does not close these gaps.
Cross-daemon exit finalization and launch-before-lease crash reconciliation; local same-owner cleanup witnesses are deliberately not reconstructible from absent files.
Unix driver setup failures after OS spawn, pre-adoption hydration/binding failures, rejected/unproven adoption lease disposition and main release-rejection early return before companion recovery.
Directory/inode substitution and complete writer API/permission inventory under the target-host security model.
Per-Agent mutation ownership, short shared registry/release commit boundaries and measured 256-process mixed load; serialized lifecycle work remains.
Canonical document/projection verification and complete current-source mapping; focused amendment documents and added test sources are not global closure.
externalEvidenceGates: exact deployed hepta-supervisord binary, host identity and externally pinned production grant/H7 verifier configuration
target-host startup, watchdog, typed Agentd drain, bounded restart and signed-recovery crash/fault/latency measurements
deployment and independent verification of the external release-policy/authority distribution feeding Fleet allow/revoke state and signer rotation
independent operational acceptance of signed upgrade, rollback and recovery outcomes
